text: Paper · Preprint · arXiv 2609.04148 Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories into Scalable Terminal Environments Jie Wu, Zhenru Zhang (project leader), Beichen Zhang, Xuwu Wang, Yuhui Su, Mouxiang Chen, Peng Wang, Zhihai Wang, Que Shen, Hao Zhou, An Yang, Fei Huang, Yujiu Yang, Dayiheng Liu (corresponding authors Yujiu Yang and Dayiheng Liu) Qwen Team, Alibaba Group, and Tsinghua University (Jie Wu worked on it as a Qwen intern) · 3 September 2026 (arXiv v1, the only version so far) In one line: Agent trajectories already contain their own environments, because the file operations they recorded can be replayed: rebuild the workspace from the log, fill missing dependencies, then grow tasks by breadth (cross-workspace queries) and depth (single-turn extended into multi-round with feedback), yielding 37,300 runnable environments from public traces; fine-tuning Qwen3.5-27B gives +11.9 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and +13.8 on EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4, and closes an agents-to-trajectories-to-environments-to-agents flywheel.
